translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Esira iviloubusi Yerusalem
Kwaivila taitu bogwa leiwokuva, ola tuta Atasakisa

matauna guyoula Pesia, e baisa isisu taitala tau yagala Esira. Ivayelu liliusi tubula metoya baisa Eroni, matauwena Tolula Toveka, e kasi bawa baisa makawala ka - Esira matauna tamala Seraia, e eisakaili tamala Asaraia, eisakaili tamala Ilikaia,
eisakaili tamala Salum, eisakaili tamala Sadoki, eisakaili tamala Aituba,
eisakaili tamala Amaraia, eisakaili tamala Asaraia, eisakaili tamala Meraioti,
eisakaili tamala Seraia, eisakaili tamala Usisi, eisakaili tamala Buki,
eisakaili tamala Abisuwa, eisakaili tamala Peniasi, eisakaili tamala Eleasa, e matauna tamala Eroni.

Esira matauna toninitalapula deli tokabitam paila karaiwaga makwaisina Guyau si Yaubada mina Isireli bogwa eisaiki Mosese. Paila Guyau Yaubada bogwa eikabwaili Esira, e mapaila guyoula Pesia isaiki matauna vavagi komwaidona avaka einigadi. Olumoulela kwailima kwaiyuwela taitu
ola karaiwaga Atasakisa, Esira isilavi Babilonia bila Yerusalem deli yuwotala mina Isireli, deli goli tolula, mina Libai, Bwala Kwebumaboma kala towosi, toyamata Bwala Kwebumaboma, e deli topaisewa.
Isilavaisi Babilonia namatalela tubukona yamla kwaimatala Yaubada ipilasi si loula e mapaila iviloubusisi Yerusalem tubukona nalimela yamla kwaimatala.
Esira itugwali la momova paila binevi kala nikoli la karaiwaga Guyau Yaubada, e bikatukikiti deli bivituloki komwaidona karaiwaga kidikedala baisa mina Isireli.
Atasakisa isaiki Esira la karaiwaga pweipula

Atasakisa bogwa eisaiki yatala pweipula karaiwaga baisa Esira, e matauna tolula deli toninitalapula, bogwa eikabitam paila karaiwaga makwaisina Guyau bogwa eisaiki mina Isireli. E miyana pweipu isim kala ginigini baisa makawala.
“Yeigu guyau Atasakisa agini baisa Esira matauna tolula e toninitalapula paila la karaiwaga Yaubada Towalakaiwa.
“Yeigu akaraiwogi oluwalaisi ulo kabokwaraiwaga komwaidona kidamwa komwaidosi mina Isireli, tolula deli mina Libai, availa availa magisi baisa, ibodi batagwala bilosi deli yoku mapilana Yerusalem.

Yeigu deli kasitailima kasitaiyu kaidadala valu kawitalaimsi paila bukuvakawoli ammakawala si kaisisu mina Yerusalem deli mina Yuda, paila bukugisi ammakawala si kabikaula baisa la karaiwaga mi Yaubada, makwaina karaiwaga Yaubada bogwa eisakaimi mwada bukukwabikuwolaisi.
Bukukwau deli yoku ulo semakavi goula deli siliba, makwaisina yeigu deli kaidadala valu lakatagwalasi lakasakaisi baisa mina Isireli si Yaubada, matauna la Bwala Kwebumaboma isisu mapilana Yerusalem.

E tuvaila bukukwau komwaidona pokala siliba deli goula, makwaisina lokukwauwaisi olumoulela makwaina valu vilouveka Babilonia, deli goli mina Isireli deli tolula si semakavi avaka isakaisi paila si Yaubada la Bwala Kwebumaboma olumoulela Yerusalem.

“Yoku bukuyamati mani baisa kala gimwala bibwaina, e bukugimoli bulumakau nammwala, sipi nammwala, lam, witi, deli waini, e bukugubukwaisi lula okabolula olumoulela Bwala Kwebumaboma mapilana Yerusalem.
Ibodi yoku bukuyosi kesala makwaisina siliba deli goula e bukuvagi avaka ninami yoku deli kam viloumgwa. Mitaga bibodi wala bukuvagaisi makawala nanola mi Yaubada.
Bukusaiki Yaubada mapilana Yerusalem guguwa makwaisina leisakaimsi paila Bwala Kwebumaboma kala wotetila.
E ka, avai vavagi tuvaila magim paila Bwala Kwebumaboma, ibodi bukukwau mipusi manila metoya baisa gweguya si kabosisaila mani.

“Yeigu akaraiwogi komwaidomi mani kala toyamata olumoulela mapilana Yupereiti Opilikwaibwaga kidamwa nanakwa bukusakaisi Esira avaka avaka binigadaimi, matauwena Esira tolula deli toninitalapula paila la karaiwaga Yaubada Towalakaiwa.

Bukusakaisi goli siliba bila isakaila makawala gulotala taitu uvalima uvavasi (3,400 kg), kwailuwotala tani witi (10,000 kg), 2,000 lukwavala waini, 2,000 lukwavala bulamila olibe, deli kuyobauwaisi wala yona kala bawa.

Ibodi bukuyamatasi bibwaina paila bukusakaisi vavagi komwaidona makwaisina avaka Yaubada Towalakaiwa magila paila la Bwala Kwebumaboma, e bukuvagaisi bibwaina, taga bigibuluwaigu kaina availa matausina bikaimapwaigusi.
Yokomi bomami bukukwatuyoulasi avai pokala metoya baisa tolula, mina Libai, tousiwosi, toyamata, topaisewa tauwau kaina availa deli iwotetilasi wa Bwala Kwebumaboma.

“E mwa! Esira, metoya kabitam makwaina m Yaubada bogwa leisakaim, yoku bukunagi tokwaraiwaga deli toyakala paila bikaraiwogaisi tomota mabudosina availa availa ikabikuwolaisi la karaiwaga m Yaubada, olumoulela mapilana Yupereiti Opilikwaibwaga. Ibodi bukuvituloki karaiwaga makwaina baisa availa availa gala inikolaisi makwaina.

Kidamwa availa availa matausina bikoulovaisi la karaiwaga m Yaubada, kainaga bikoulovaisi ulo kabokwaraiwaga karaiwogala, ibodi nanakwa matausina bibodaisi kasi mipuki. E kasi mipuki ibodi kaina bikaligasi, kaina biyuwolaisi, kaina si guguwa bikoumakavaisi, kainaga bilosi okatupipi.”
Esira iyakawoli Yaubada
Esira ikaibiga, kawala, “Kala yakaula Guyau, matauna si Yaubada tubudoiasi! Matauna eiviyelu nanola guyoula Pesia kidamwa bitemmali Guyau la Bwala Kwebumaboma baisa makawala.

Metoya Yaubada ola mitakwai, yeigu bogwa labani la ninabwaila guyoula Pesia, deli kaidadala la valu e deli komwaidona la tosikwawa topapeula. Guyau ulo Yaubada bogwa ivigakaigu batuvaluwa, e mauula gagabila bavisivili bidubadu todidabala mabudosina boda olumoulela dala dilatala dilatala mina Isireli kidamwa bikaimilavausi deli yeigu.”

footnotes.text: Matauwena taiyuwela Atasakisa, tadoki Atasakisa II, matauna guyoula Pesia 404-358 BC.
